tasks.short: Define test data requirements and set up equipment

steps.what: Identify required data, acquisition plans and test parameters from engineering objectives
outputs: defined acquisition plan and test parameters

steps.what: Set up equipment to conform to the specified test requirements
inputs: defined acquisition plan and test parameters
outputs: equipment arranged for the planned test

tasks.design: Keep test planning and physical equipment setup with the technician using {DOCS} and {OTHER}, the test equipment control system. Reusing a stored setup does not establish that it is suitable for the next test.
tasks.previous_blocker: Test objectives and physical configurations vary across parts and experiments.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing test specifications and equipment records support planning.
tasks.still_hard: Choose meaningful measurements and recognise configuration hazards.
tasks.human_edge: Relate the engineering question to a defensible physical setup.
tasks.altitude: Own the connection between test objectives and equipment setup.

evidence.claim: Test planning and physical setup retain full time; no repeatable automatic configuration contract is established.

assumptions: OTHER denotes the test equipment control system.
The technician defines and documents the plan in s1 and performs physical setup in s2; calibration and operating the acquisition system belong to the separate operation task.
No new automation is introduced, so there is no additional maintenance.
research_questions: Are there repeatable setup checks that can be measured separately from engineering planning?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Requirement selection and physical setup retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with engineers about test procedures and results

steps.what: Confer with engineering personnel about details and implications of test procedures and results

tasks.design: Retain discussion and engineering interpretation through {DOCS} and {CHAT}. Source results can be referenced directly; no separate minutes-production baseline is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedural implications depend on engineering context and shared interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing shared test records support discussion.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve differing interpretations and decide what further testing is needed.
tasks.human_edge: Explain observations and question assumptions with engineers.
tasks.altitude: Make technically useful contributions to engineering decisions.

evidence.claim: Substantive technical consultation retains full time in this design.

assumptions: The baseline is consultation, excluding test acquisition and report formatting counted in their own tasks.
No new tool or maintenance is added.
unknowns: Discussion format and recurrent preparation burden
research_questions: Is repeated evidence retrieval a measurable burden distinct from technical consultation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Discussion and engineering interpretation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Operate and calibrate test acquisition and analysis systems

steps.what: Operate and calibrate computer systems and devices for required acquisition and analysis

tasks.design: Retain calibration, operation and analysis checks with the technician using {OTHER}, the existing test acquisition system. Instrument sampling already performed by equipment creates no new labour saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Calibration and operating validity depend on physical references and test conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing acquisition systems record measurements and supply analysis functions.
tasks.still_hard: Recognise invalid calibration, sensor behaviour and analysis assumptions.
tasks.human_edge: Establish whether the acquired measurements can be trusted.
tasks.altitude: Own measurement validity during test operation.

evidence.claim: DewesoftX records test data and produces reports; this capability does not establish savings in physical calibration or test operation.

assumptions: OTHER denotes the test acquisition and analysis system.
The baseline includes calibration, operation and analysis checks; initial physical setup is counted in its own task.
Existing automatic sampling is retained without claiming it as new automation.
No added service is installed, so there is no additional maintenance.
research_questions: Is any repeated operational configuration burden both measurable and absent from existing acquisition software?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Calibration and operating checks remain; existing automatic acquisition earns no new saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record and interpret test data for parts and assemblies

steps.what: Select test data for parts and check identifiers, units and acquisition provenance
Record selected test data as traceable tables and plots in the report
outputs: draft test record with source links

steps.what: Interpret test data, verify recorded plots and explain unresolved anomalies
inputs: draft test record with source links

tasks.design: Configure native reporting in {OTHER}, the test acquisition system, to place selected tables and plots in {DOCS}. Keep data selection, unit and provenance checks and engineering interpretation with the technician; the output is a draft for the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technicians may repeatedly transfer acquired readings into test records.
tasks.enabler_now: Test acquisition software can generate reports directly from selected source data.
tasks.still_hard: Interpret anomalies and judge whether test conditions support conclusions.
tasks.human_edge: Explain meaning and limitations beyond a plotted signal.
tasks.altitude: Spend record preparation time on interpretation and traceability.

evidence.claim: DewesoftX records test data and produces PDF or Word reports.
The proposed recording shares and savings are unmeasured model knowledge, not a documented aerospace result.

assumptions: OTHER denotes the test acquisition system; use native reporting before building an integration.
The acquisition operator produces raw files during the separate operation task; that capture time earns no saving here and is not duplicated.

In s1 the technician captures and verifies run ID, part and assembly ID, file version, channels, units, timestamps, calibration reference and plot selection; its 20 hours includes missing-field clarification.
Missing provenance or incompatible files return to manual recording and checking in s3; no automatic pass/fail or safety verdict is generated.
Seven added focal hours cover report mappings and regression checks; already automatic record production yields no saving.
research_questions: Does native report generation save recording time after selection, traceability checks and maintenance?

already_counted.description: Recording packet capture and provenance checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=65; gross 35 minus 7 focal upkeep gives central net 28. E1 range 0-20 allows existing native reports and incompatible runs; interpretation retains full time.

role.altitude: Reduce repeatable test recording while protecting measurement validity and engineering interpretation.
reach: Resolve calibration issues with metrology specialists
role.ambitious_version: An aerospace technician who produces traceable test records with less transfer work and retains responsibility for setup, calibration and interpretation.
